name: Kent Spring 2023
information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KentSpring2023#26714-please-read-competitor-responsibilities) tab. All WCA competitions are open to everyone regardless of age. This competition is geared towards beginners and first-timers however anyone can attend.
